Big Tech/AI.title: Nvidia to buy developer platform Hugging Face in $12.9bn deal
Big Tech/AI.summary: Nvidia agreed to acquire AI platform Hugging Face for $12.9 billion to secure its position in open-source developer ecosystems.

Semiconductors.title: Canaan Inc. to Report Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results on September 8, 2026
Semiconductors.summary: Canaan Inc. announced it will release its unaudited second quarter 2026 financial results on September 8, 2026.

Semiconductors.title: No shortcut to excellence in chips: TSMC executive
Semiconductors.summary: TSMC leadership emphasized continuous long-term R&D over shortcuts to maintain manufacturing dominance in advanced packaging and AI chips.

Finance.title: WaFd, Inc. Enters into a $3.9 Billion Reverse Merger Transaction with EverBank Financial Corp
Finance.summary: WaFd and EverBank agreed to a definitive $3.9 billion reverse merger combining into a premier national commercial bank.

Finance.title: Bank of Montreal Receives Regulatory Approvals for Normal Course Issuer Bid
Finance.summary: Bank of Montreal received regulatory approval to repurchase up to 20 million shares starting September 8, 2026.

Healthcare.title: FDA Approves Camizestrant Combination Regimen for Locally Advanced or Metastatic Breast Cancer
Healthcare.summary: The US FDA granted accelerated approval to AstraZeneca's camizestrant in combination with CDK4/6 inhibitors for ESR1-mutated breast cancer.

Energy.title: OPEC+ keeps oil output policy unchanged for October
Energy.summary: OPEC+ decided to keep October oil production quotas unchanged from September levels, pausing previously planned output increases.

Macro.title: UBS: Two Fed Hikes Incoming, but Equity Bull Case Still Intact
Macro.summary: UBS forecasted two Federal Reserve interest rate hikes in 2026 after stronger-than-expected US August nonfarm payrolls.
